_meta.name: grouped_correlation_matrix
_meta.description: Per-arm Pearson correlation matrices on experiment.pulse: matrices follow Request.Groups, so GROUP_CATEGORY on treatment returns one MAT_CORRELATION result per non-empty arm, in the grouped data-row order, each carrying group_key and group_header. Predict reports bucket_basis dictionary with estimated_buckets 2 and the estimated cells and bytes before the run.
